subject: Access latch: token sync and login failures for Olympus supplier admin
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@olympussuppliers.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: support@olympussuppliers.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Cannot complete supplier admin onboarding - token mismatch

Hi Vanessa,

We're trying to claim the supplier admin account at Olympus Suppliers, but every time our admin clicks the portal link the page shows an 'Access latch: token mismatch' error. We received the invite yesterday and attempted twice from two different machines. Attached is a screenshot of the error and a short crash log from the browser console.

This is blocking our procurement team — we have a PO ready to sign and need supplier account setup to receive POs. Can you advise urgently?

What we tried:
- Cleared browser cookies and tried incognito
- Used a different admin email (same org)
- Restarted machines

Attachments: screenshot_login_flow.png (PNG), olympus_error_log.txt (text)

Thanks,
Claire Nguyen
Procurement Operations
Olympus Suppliers Inc.

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@olympussuppliers.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cannot complete supplier admin onboarding - token mismatch

Hi Claire — thanks for the quick note and the attachments. Sorry you're blocked. I'm looping in Ben (onboarding lead) and Rafael (SRE) so we can troubleshoot the token issue and get your admin claimed today.

A couple quick questions while we triage:
- Did the admin click the invite link more than once? Re-using the same link after an initial failure can sometimes trigger a token mismatch.
- Is your org using SSO (SAML/OIDC) to access the portal, or are you signing up with an email + password flow?

Immediate next steps from our side:
- Ben/Rafael: please check whether the invite token expired or if there's a clock skew between our signing service and Olympus tenant (we've seen TTL drift cause this specific error).
- Claire: if possible, can you paste the full error_id shown on the page (e.g., ERR-TOKEN-XXXX)? That will speed lookup.

I've opened a HubSpot ticket and linked the screenshots (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/ticket/OLY-4892). Will update here.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@olympussuppliers.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cannot complete supplier admin onboarding - token mismatch

Thanks for the context — looping in Rafael for logs. Claire, copying the triage steps we ran and what to try next: 

Observed: the portal returned an "Access latch: token mismatch" when validating the invite token. This is often caused by one of three things:
1) The invite token TTL expired (default 24h)
2) The user clicked an old link after a new invite was generated (link reuse)
3) A clock skew between the invite-issuing service and the portal validation (rare, but we've seen it when tenant clocks differ by >2 minutes)

Quick fixes to try now (low risk):
- Claire: please ask your admin to try the private/incognito link one more time; if it fails, do NOT attempt more than twice.
- Vanessa/Rafael: we'll invalidate the current token server-side and re-issue a fresh invite with a 48-hour TTL. I'll include a single-use claim code in the email to avoid link reuse issues.

Rafael — can you pull the validation trace for token id that appears in olympus_error_log.txt? The important fields are: issued_at, expires_at, tenant_id, and signature_kid. If there's drift, we can re-sign with the portal's current time window.

For reference, if you want to confirm locally, here's the curl we used to inspect token metadata (internal):

  curl -s -X POST https://internal-auth.redwood.local/token/inspect \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
    -d 'token=ERR-TOKEN-XXXX' | jq '.issued_at, .expires_at, .tenant_id'

I'll regenerate the invite now and send a single-use code. Claire, expect an email from invites@redwoodinference.com in the next 10 minutes.

--
Ben Carter
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@olympussuppliers.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cannot complete supplier admin onboarding - token mismatch

Thanks Ben and Vanessa — that did the trick. We received the new single-use claim code and the admin completed the portal claim without errors. Olympus procurement was able to attach the PO to the account and the DocuSign flow is moving.

Quick notes for your records:
- The original token in olympus_error_log.txt had issued_at: 2026-10-31T14:03:12Z and expires_at: 2026-11-01T14:03:12Z — looks like a TTL expiry plus our admin attempted reuse after a failed OAuth redirect.
- No SSO was in use; classic email flow.

Please close the HubSpot ticket OLY-4892 when convenient. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Claire Nguyen
Procurement Operations
Olympus Suppliers Inc.
